plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: General development tooling skills, and the pr-reviewer, security-reviewer, verifier, finding-checker, and merge-judge agents.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Process and workflow skills (planning, decisions, research, writing).

plugins.name: in-progress
plugins.description: Skills being actively authored or rewritten. Installable for dogfooding; expect churn until they graduate.

plugins.name: guard-worktree
plugins.description: Mod: refuses edits in a repo's main checkout until the work moves to a worktree off a freshly fetched origin default branch. Skips a GitHub repo whose default branch is unprotected.

plugins.name: guard-infra
plugins.description: Mod: asks before each aws, kubectl, helm, or terraform apply/destroy call that is not a read. Ships a sandbox config where every call runs in the sandbox first, with no AWS or EKS access, and asks nothing about a sandboxed call. A call that fails there retries outside it with the permission mode's review, and the guard asks before a write in that retry.

plugins.name: watch-discussions
plugins.description: Mod: watches the PRs and connector calls that Claude picks with its watch tool, and each PR the session opens. New items reach the session during a turn, and start a turn while it is idle.

plugins.name: tidy-transcript
plugins.description: Mod: folds each run of tool calls into one line, and a mod's prompt into one line.

plugins.name: show-session
plugins.description: Mod: /show-session opens a pane with the session's skills, folders, shell commands, and agents.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Skills for maintaining this marketplace itself (import, refresh, merge). Not useful in other repos.

plugins.name: deprecated
plugins.description: Skills phased out. Still installable to ease the transition; will be removed once unused.
